layers.title: HiRISE 0.25 m Optical Basemap
layers.native_resolution: 0.25 m/px (exported at ~4.94 m/px for ops box)
layers.limitations: Static orbital mosaic; does not resolve loose sand depth or transient ripples.

layers.title: 1 m DEM Hillshade Relief
layers.source_product: Horn hillshade (315 deg az, 45 deg alt) from Mars Trek Gale_DEM_SMG_1m
layers.limitations: Stereo DTM precision ~0.25-1 m vertical; subtle stereo seam steps possible.

layers.title: Slope Hazard (>15 deg Hard Limit)
layers.native_resolution: ~9.88 m planning cell (max of 2x2 sub-grid Horn slope)
layers.source_product: Dual-aggregated Horn slope (slope_max_deg enforces 15 deg block; slope_mean_deg feeds Pandolf)
layers.limitations: 15 deg is a configurable team Scenario limit (no official NASA suited Mars slope standard exists); sub-meter boulders are unresolved.

layers.title: THEMIS Thermal Inertia Sand Proxy
layers.source_product: USGS ARD CC0 THEMIS Controlled NIR Mosaic (mc23_aeolis_nir) -> Pandolf eta [1.05..2.05]
layers.limitations: 100 m/px coarse indicator (~20% TI uncertainty, Fergason et al. 2006); TI->eta is a labeled team transfer function, not boot-scale ground truth.

layers.title: CRISM Hydrated Minerals (Sulfates)
layers.limitations: Maps sulfate-bearing host unit at 18-36 m/px; cm-scale boxwork veins are below CRISM pixel resolution and identified by Curiosity surface imaging.

layers.title: CRISM Phyllosilicates (Clays)
layers.limitations: Derived spectral summary parameter browse; indicates Fe/Mg-smectite clay affinity in lower Mount Sharp.

layers.title: USGS SIM 3292 Geologic Units
layers.source_product: USGS SIM 3292 Geologic Map of Mars (Tanaka et al. 2014) — Unit Htu
layers.limitations: 1:20M global map (mound maps as unit Htu); regional stratigraphic context only, not walk-scale composition.

layers.title: Habitat Comms Line-of-Sight (LOS)
layers.native_resolution: ~9.88 m DEM raycast (3.0 m mast -> 1.6 m suit)
layers.source_product: Curved-Mars geometric viewshed on Gale_DEM_SMG_1m (incl. d^2/2R drop)
layers.limitations: Geometric terrain LOS only; does not model UHF diffraction, multipath, or orbiter relay passes.

layers.title: Backward-Dijkstra Returnability Envelope
layers.native_resolution: ~9.88 m planning grid (nominal 420 L O2, 25% reserve)
layers.source_product: Scipy backward-Dijkstra return-cost field (Back_o2) from scenario habitat
layers.limitations: Scenario estimate assuming Pandolf 1-g metabolism transferred to Mars and 25% team reserve policy.
